def check_constraints():
    from z3 import Solver, Int, sat

    s = Solver()

    curr_dev = Int('curr_dev')
    curr_net = Int('curr_net')
    sublist = Int('sublist')
    dev = Int('dev')
    net = Int('net')
    skb = Int('skb')

    s.add(curr_dev == 0)
    s.add(curr_net == 0)
    s.add(sublist == 0)
    s.add(dev != 0)
    s.add(net != 0)
    s.add(skb != 0)
    s.add(curr_dev != dev)
    s.add(sublist == 0)
    s.add(curr_dev == dev)
    s.add(curr_net == net)

    result = s.check()
    return result == sat
